**Zee Medical** primarily packages, labels, and distributes its own private-label first-aid, safety, and over-the-counter medication products (such as_

Zee Pain Aid

_and_

Dilotab

_) rather than operating as a multi-brand reseller of major external medical device manufacturers. [](https://www.pharmacompass.com/pdf/news/enforcement-report-week-of-february-9-2022-1644385243.pdf)

_(Note: If you were instead searching for **Zee Laboratories**—the large Indian pharmaceutical manufacturer often associated with retail chains like [Zeelab Pharmacy](https://zeelabpharmacy.com/)—they manufacture thousands of generic formulations across dozens of internal divisions like [Klokter](https://zeelaboratories.com/klokter-lifesciences-a-complete-guide-to-zee-laboratories-multi-specialty-pcd-division/) and [Medibruck](https://zeelaboratories.com/medibruck-klokter-grentek-inside-zees-multi-specialty-portfolio/), rather than distributing outside brands)._ [](https://zeelabpharmacy.com/)

Zee Laboratories operates as the core WHO-GMP certified manufacturing parent company, managing over 23 specialized divisions, brand names, and franchise partnerships across global markets. _(Note: If you meant the historical U.S.-based safety/first-aid supplier [Zee Medical](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/zeemedical/__ZFpNnPzkzsXyi3ELipuQxDcFjYfe5Lsyxh7PtDCFlII), it operated as an independent service provider rather than a pharma manufacturer)._ [](https://zeelaboratories.com/otc-generic-medicines-trusted-names-in-everyday-healthcare/)

Zee structures its vast array of formulations across distinct parallel divisions to support franchise networks: [](https://zeelaboratories.com/medibruck-klokter-grentek-inside-zees-multi-specialty-portfolio/)

- **Multi-Specialty Divisions:** Klokter, Lanark, Axyzen Lifesciences, Bionext, Medibruck, Grentek, Cecel, Wel'n'drug, and ADPL.

- **Super-Specialty & Care Divisions:** Altrex (ophthalmic), Concord (psychiatric), Biorome (derma), Oreva, Cardiways, Petbest & Vetlife (veterinary), and Zee Herbal.

- **Ethical & Generic Lines:** Aqualive (IV fluids), Nephro, Oncozest, Elwin, and Zee Drugs. [](https://zeelaboratories.com/klokter-lifesciences-a-complete-guide-to-zee-laboratories-multi-specialty-pcd-division/)

### Manufacturer Structure & Partnerships

- **Manufacturing Base:** Relies on dedicated WHO-GMP certified facilities producing over 5,000 FDA-approved and certified formulations.

- **Distribution Model:** Operates widely through PCD (Propaganda Cum Distribution) pharma franchise networks and the [Zeelab Pharmacy](https://zeelabpharmacy.com/partner) retail generic chain. [](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DWIyG6Pia7f/?hl=en)
